title: VISOR: Agentic Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Iterative Search and Over-horizon Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2604.09508v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (VRAG) empowers Vision-Language Models to retrieve and reason over visually rich documents. To tackle complex queries requiring multi-step reasoning, agentic VRAG systems interleave reasoning with iterative retrieval. However, existing agentic VRAG faces two critical bottlenecks. (1) Visual Evidence Sparsity: key evidence is scattered across pages yet processed in isolation, hindering cross-page reasoning; moreover, fine-grained intra-image evidence often requires precise visual actions, whose misuse degrades retrieval quality; (2) Search Drift in Long Horizons: the accumulation of visual tokens across retrieved pages dilutes context and causes cognitive overload, leading agents to deviate from their search objective. To address these challenges, we propose VISOR (Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Iterative Search and Over-horizon Reasoning), a unified single-agent framework. VISOR

translated_title: VISOR：通过迭代搜索与超视距推理的代理式视觉检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 视觉检索增强生成（VRAG）使视觉语言模型能够检索并推理视觉丰富的文档。为应对需要多步推理的复杂查询，代理式VRAG系统将推理与迭代检索交织进行。然而，现有代理式VRAG面临两个关键瓶颈。（1）视觉证据稀疏性：关键证据分散在多个页面中，但被孤立处理，阻碍了跨页面推理；此外，细粒度的图像内证据通常需要精确的视觉操作，其误用会降低检索质量；（2）长视距中的搜索漂移：检索页面中视觉标记的累积会稀释上下文并导致认知过载，使代理偏离其搜索目标。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了VISOR（通过迭代搜索与超视距推理的视觉检索增强生成），一个统一的单代理框架。
tldr: VISOR通过迭代搜索和超视距推理，在单一代理框架中解决了视觉检索增强生成中的视觉证据稀疏和长视距搜索漂移问题，显著提升了复杂查询的推理能力。
en_tdlr: VISOR addresses visual evidence sparsity and long-horizon search drift in visual retrieval-augmented generation through iterative search and over-horizon reasoning within a unified single-agent framework, enhancing complex query reasoning.
